items.t: Solar Stocks Rebound After A Brutal Rout: Is The Worst Over For ENPH, FSLR, CSIQ, SEDG Stocks?
items.sum: Solar stocks have been pressured by a mix of elevated Treasury yields, softer-than-expected demand, policy and tax-credit shifts, and earnings misses across major industry players.

items.t: First Solar and Enphase Fall 5% as Solar Selloff Stretches On; SolarEdge Drops 4%
items.sum: The election bounce lifted solar stocks for a few days, then rate fears took it all back. With earnings beats hiding weak revenue and a one-time tariff windfall, was the rally ever real for First Solar, Enphase, and SolarEdge?

items.t: Wells Fargo Maintains Equal-Weight on SolarEdge Technologies, Lowers Price Target to $26
items.sum: Wells Fargo analyst Praneeth Satish maintains SolarEdge Technologies (NASDAQ:SEDG) with a Equal-Weight and lowers the price target from $36 to $26.

items.t: SolarEdge Technologies (SEDG) Looks Cheap After Yield Pressure Clouds A Tariff Helped Beat
